adjudication.rationale:
Confirmed: P106 = Neoplastic Process, so applicable; definition is 'a benign or malignant neoplasm which is not further characterized'. Its single role (R105 -> C12922 Neoplastic Cell) is the universal generic neoplastic cell present on every neoplasm and carries no pre-coordinated dimension. Genuinely atomic, not residual: there is nothing unresolved, there is nothing to decompose.

CROSS-REVIEW CONSOLIDATION: FULL AGREEMENT on concept status, outcome, and expected pair set.
